from preferences import Preferences
from repository import MissingPreference, Repository, ScriptedBackend, TransientRead

result = {'color': 'blue'}
backend = ScriptedBackend([result, {'unused': True}])
assert Preferences(Repository(backend)).read('w') is result
assert backend.keys == ['w']
assert next(backend.outcomes) == {'unused': True}
print('PASS: normalized ID succeeds without consuming another outcome')

backend = ScriptedBackend([TransientRead('first'), TransientRead('second'), result])
assert Preferences(Repository(backend)).read('\\t w \\n') is result
assert backend.keys == ['w', 'w', 'w']
print('PASS: third attempt succeeds with the normalized ID on every attempt')

missing = MissingPreference('missing')
backend = ScriptedBackend([TransientRead('first'), missing, result])
try:
    Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(' w ')
except MissingPreference as error:
    assert error is missing
else:
    raise AssertionError('permanent error did not propagate')
assert backend.keys == ['w', 'w']
assert next(backend.outcomes) is result
print('PASS: permanent error after a transient error stops retries immediately')
PY"
